favorites.benefits: The tomatoes in this dish are high in lycopene, an antioxidant that has been linked to reduced risk of certain cancers and heart disease. Garlic has been shown to have antibacterial and antiviral properties, and may help to support immune function. Basil is a rich source of vitamins A and K, and has been traditionally used to support digestive health. Olive oil is high in healthy fats, which can help to support heart health and satisfy hunger. Whole wheat spaghetti provides a good source of complex carbohydrates and fiber, which can help to support healthy blood sugar levels and digestive function.
favorites.name: Spaghetti al Pomodoro
favorites.nutrition:
Calories: ~420 kcal
Protein: 10g
Carbohydrates: 70g
Fat: 15g
Fiber: 6g
Sodium: 200mg
favorites.pairing: This dish pairs well with a simple green salad, roasted vegetables, or a side of sautéed spinach. A dry and crisp white wine, such as Pinot Grigio, can complement the bright and tangy flavors of the tomato sauce. For a more traditional Italian meal, serve with a side of garlic bread or grilled bread, and finish with a sweet treat like tiramisu or gelato.
process: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti for 8-10 minutes, or until al dente.
While the spaghetti is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the saucepan and sauté for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomatoes to the saucepan and stir to combine with the garlic and oil.
Season the tomato sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the tomato sauce for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped basil and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the spaghetti.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the tomato sauce and toss to combine, adding some reserved pasta water if the sauce seems too thick.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then sprinkle with nutritional yeast (vegan parmesan substitute).
Serve immediately, garnished with additional basil if desired.
tips: Use high-quality ingredients, such as San Marzano tomatoes, for the best flavor.
Don't overcook the spaghetti, as it can become mushy and unappetizing.
Add some acidity, such as a squeeze of lemon juice, to balance the richness of the dish.
Experiment with different types of tomatoes, such as cherry or grape tomatoes, for a varied flavor and texture.

favorites.name: Chicken Chow Mein
favorites.nutrition:
Calories: ~420 kcal
Protein: 35g
Carbohydrates: 30g
Fat: 20g
Fiber: 4g
Sodium: 450mg
favorites.pairing: Serve the Chicken Chow Mein with a side of raita, a yogurt and cucumber sauce, to help cool down the palate. Alternatively, serve with a side of papadum or naan bread to add some crunch and texture to the meal. A glass of mango lassi or a cup of chai tea can also help to complement the flavors of the dish.
process: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium heat for 2 minutes
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 3-4 minutes
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes
Add the prawns curry sauce and stir to combine, cooking for an additional 2 minutes
Cook the noodles according to the package instructions and drain well
Add the cooked noodles to the wok or frying pan and stir to combine with the chicken and sauce
Add the sesame oil and salt to taste, stirring to combine
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions or cilantro if desired
tips: Use fresh and high-quality ingredients to ensure the best flavor and texture
Cook the noodles al dente to prevent them from becoming mushy and unappetizing
Add the sesame oil at the end of cooking to preserve its delicate flavor and nutritional properties
Use a variety of spices and seasonings to add depth and complexity to the dish

searchHistory.nutrition:

Protein: 35g
Carbohydrates: 30g
Fat: 20g
Fiber: 4g
Sodium: 450mg
searchHistory.pairing: Serve Chicken Chow Mein with a side of steamed dumplings or egg rolls for a classic Chinese meal. A simple green salad with a light vinaigrette dressing can also provide a refreshing contrast to the rich and savory flavors of the dish. For a drink, consider serving Chinese tea, such as jasmine or green tea, to complement the meal.
process: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions, about 3-5 minutes
Drain the noodles and set them aside
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, oyster sauce (if using), and sesame oil
Cut the chicken into thin strips and season with salt and pepper
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set it aside
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil
Add the sliced onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 2 minutes
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they are tender-crisp, about 2-3 minutes
Return the cooked chicken to the skillet and pour in the soy sauce mixture
Stir everything together to combine and cook for another minute
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir-fry everything together for about 2 minutes
tips: Use fresh and high-quality ingredients to ensure the best flavor and texture
Cook the noodles al dente to prevent them from becoming mushy
Don't overcook the vegetables, as they should retain some crunch
Add the soy sauce mixture towards the end of cooking to prevent the noodles from becoming too salty

favorites.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
favorites.nutrition:
Calories: ~420 kcal
Protein: 37g
Carbohydrates: 20g
Fat: 24g
Fiber: 4g
Sodium: 450mg
favorites.pairing: This dish is typically served with basmati rice or naan bread, and can be paired with a side of raita or a salad. For a more authentic experience, serve with a side of papadum or pickles. A glass of mango lassi or a cup of chai can complement the flavors of the dish.
process: Marinate the chicken breast in a mixture of 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder, 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder, 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder, 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder, 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder, and 1/4 teaspoon salt for at least 15 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the marinated chicken breast for 6-7 minutes per side, or until it is cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set it aside.
In the same pan, add another tablespoon of vegetable oil and sauté 1 medium onion, chopped, until it is translucent.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add 1 medium tomato, chopped, and cook until it is soft.

Add 1 teaspoon of garam masala powder, 1 teaspoon of cumin powder, 1 teaspoon of coriander powder, 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric powder, 1/2 teaspoon of red chili powder, and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add 2 tablespoons of tomato puree, 2 tablespoons of water, and 2 tablespoons of lemon juice. Stir well.
Add the cooked chicken back into the pan and stir to coat with the sauce.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the chicken in the sauce for 10-12 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
tips: Use high-quality spices to get the best flavor out of the dish.
Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes to get the best flavor.
Use a mixture of tomato puree and water to get the right consistency of the sauce.
Garnish with fresh cilantro to add a fresh flavor to the dish.
